intents.description: Toggle strict/standard behavior.

intents.description: Count documents (global or filtered).

intents.description: List documents (paginated).

intents.name: inventory.tree
intents.description: Show the category tree (multi-level).

intents.name: inventory.tree_sub
intents.description: Expand a subtree for a given category path.

intents.name: inventory.categories
intents.description: List categories (top-level or filtered).

intents.name: inventory.stats
intents.description: Show inventory stats (depth counts, docs per category, top categories).

intents.name: inventory.find
intents.description: Find documents by query (name/path).

intents.name: inventory.changed_since
intents.description: Show catalog changes since a timestamp.

intents.name: inventory.health
intents.description: Show catalog/index health (duplicates, missing, failed).

intents.name: rag.summarize_doc
intents.description: Summarize a specific document (prefer admin summary; else live).

intents.name: rag.summarize_live
intents.description: Generate a live (non-stored) skim+anchors summary for a document.

intents.name: rag.answer
intents.description: Answer a technical question using RAG search with sources.

intents.name: rag.cite
intents.description: Find where a claim is stated (proof) with exact sources.

intents.description: Compare documents or standards with sourced evidence.

intents.name: rag.extract
intents.description: Extract structured items (requirements, steps, tables) from sources.

intents.name: rag.summarize_topic
intents.description: Synthesize a topic across multiple documents with sources.
